# Reporter
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Personnel.
2. Reporters are to report on situations occurring on or off station, including performing interviews and broadcasting live events.
3. Press Armor is solely to be used for self defense while reporting on events in a Red Alert situation. They are not to be worn on other alert levels. Breaches of this procedure will call for the HOP or Warden to revoke the equipment.
